brief.name: Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport
brief.subject: the 2018 international terminal seen from the landside forecourt: long, low and glazed under a large sweeping curved metal roof, with the separate control tower behind

sources.what: terminal opened 2018; long glazed terminal under a sweeping curved roof

brief.notes: A very long, low glass terminal with an angular control tower cab; the roof is a big sweeping curved metal canopy that overhangs the front. Control tower stands apart. Savanna setting.

style.vernacular: modern planned capital, render and glass

brief.name: Murtala Muhammed International Airport
brief.subject: the 1979 international terminal seen from the forecourt: long concrete modernist block with the tall control tower rising from it, and the newer glass terminal beside it

features.note: tall tapered tower rising from the terminal

sources.what: international terminal 1979; newer glass terminal added later

brief.notes: Heavy concrete modernist block with strong horizontal bands; control tower is tall and attached to the terminal; a newer glass terminal sits on one side. Humid tropical Lagos with palms.

style.vernacular: concrete frames, painted render, corrugated roofs

brief.name: London Heathrow Airport Terminal 5
brief.subject: Terminal 5 seen from the forecourt: a huge rectangular steel-and-glass box under a gently undulating wave roof

sources.what: Terminal 5, opened 2008, a large glass box with a gently curved wave roof, steel structure

brief.notes: Rectangular glass-and-steel box with a long gently curved wave roof; grey temperate setting. wave roof.
